title: Two-stage residual learning for calibrated uncertainty in solar irradiance forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2611.07444v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of renewable generation requires not only point predictions but also reliable estimates of the uncertainty attached to them, particularly at extended horizons. Machine learning models are increasingly used to predict solar output, but they typically report a single value and capture the associated uncertainty poorly. The standard remedy is to train a model to predict the parameters of an assumed probability distribution directly. Here we develop an alternative two-stage method, motivated by synthetic solar signal generation, in which the forecast error is modeled separately from the expected irradiance. A first long short-term memory (LSTM) network predicts the expected global horizontal irradiance, and a second network models the distribution of the forecast error, which is added back to the mean to give both the forecast and its uncertainty. translated_title: 面向太阳辐照度预测校准不确定度的两阶段残差学习方法
translated_abstract: 可再生能源发电的准确预测不仅需要点预测值，还需要对其所附不确定度的可靠估计，尤其是在较长的时间跨度上。机器学习模型越来越多地被用于预测太阳能输出，但它们通常只报告单一数值，难以很好地捕捉相关的不确定度。标准的补救方法是训练一个模型来直接预测假设概率分布的参数。本文受合成太阳信号生成的启发，开发了一种替代性的两阶段方法，其中预测误差与预期辐照度分别建模。第一个长短期记忆（LSTM）网络预测预期的全球水平辐照度，第二个网络对预测误差的分布进行建模，该误差被加回到均值上，从而同时给出预测值及其不确定度。利用国家太阳辐射数据库的历史天气数据……
tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段残差学习方法：第一个LSTM网络预测预期太阳辐照度，第二个网络建模预测误差的分布，从而为太阳辐照度预测提供校准的不确定度估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage residual learning method in which a first LSTM network predicts the expected solar irradiance and a second network models the forecast error distribution, thereby providing calibrated uncertainty estimates for solar irradiance forecasts.
